title: fix: run an agent again when the same request repeats
author: shegerdha

gist.summary: Repeated requests to the same agent now get separate cache entries keyed by request ID, so the agent runs again and its tools can return fresh results. Entries remain scoped to the caller’s API key, and non-streaming responses still reach the caller through their cache entry. Base-model requests and the agent’s own model calls remain cached. Two identical agent requests sent at the same time start separate runs.
